title: Delaware Code, Title 19 (Labor), Chapter 38 — Delaware Expanding Access for Retirement and Necessary Saving Program
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: heading 'CHAPTER 38. Delaware Expanding Access for Retirement and Necessary Saving Program', establishing provision for the EARNS Program, session-law credit 83 Del. Laws, c. 405; listed live under Part V of the fetched Title 19 index.
notes: Chapter is in force, but § 3803 (the EARNS Program Board) is marked '[Expired]' on the register page, so the governance provisions have lapsed even though the programme provisions have not — worth a human check before relying on the governance sections. State employees' pensions are separate (29 Del. C. ch. 55). Old-age and survivors insurance is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7).
